name: Chambea en Tu PB Lima 2024
information:
Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChambeaEnTuPBLima2024#42336-registro-registration) para obtener información detallada.
Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)
Debido a cuestiones de aforo, los participantes deben evitar asistir con invitados.

See the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChambeaEnTuPBLima2024#42336-registro-registration) tab for detailed information.
Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)
Due to capacity limitations, participants should avoid attending with guests.
